description: This file contains utility functions and hardware initialization code for MPU (Memory Protection Unit) and fault handling on STM32F7 microcontrollers, including stack management, exception handling, and peripheral setup.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates remaining stack space based on current stack pointer and thread info, with different implementations for GCC and IAR compilers.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware components, resets cycle counter, and sets BOR level.

methods.name: _unhandled_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions by triggering a panic.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Collects register values from a fault stack for postmortem debugging.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handles hard fault exceptions, with optional assembly code for context capture.

methods.name: isUnderDebugger
methods.description: Checks if the system is running under debugger control.

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects CAN device based on RX and TX pin validity.

methods.name: getSpiAf
methods.description: Returns the alternate function number for a given SPI driver.

methods.name: getMisoPin
methods.description: Returns the MISO pin for a specific SPI device.

methods.name: getMosiPin
methods.description: Returns the MOSI pin for a specific SPI device.

methods.name: getSckPin
methods.description: Returns the SCK pin for a specific SPI device.

methods.name: turnOnSpi
methods.description: Initializes and enables SPI peripheral for a given device.

methods.name: initSpiModule
methods.description: Configures SPI pins and mode for a specific SPI driver.

methods.name: initSpiCs
methods.description: Initializes chip select pin for SPI communication.
